To install Bun v1.4.4
```bash
curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash
# or you can use npm
# npm install -g bun
```

Windows:
```bash
powershell -c "irm bun.com/install.ps1|iex"
```

To upgrade to Bun v1.4.4:
```bash
bun upgrade
```

denoland/deno.body:
### 2.9.8 / 2026.10.21

- fix(compile): check read permission for dynamically imported local files
  (#36925)
- fix(completions): complete script paths for bare deno run in zsh (#36976)
- fix(core): keep op contexts alive until the isolate is disposed (#37026)
- fix(coverage): skip the V8 code cache while collecting coverage (#36901)
- fix(ext/fetch): bump hyper-util to 0.1.21 and hyper to 1.11.1 to cancel idle
  interval when pool empties (#36968)
- fix(ext/napi): check napi_create_dataview bounds for overflow (#36962)
- fix(ext/napi): ignore the callback return value while an exception is pending
  (#36942)
- fix(ext/node): align X.509v1 certificate handling with OpenSSL (#36933)
- fix(ext/node): mock.reset() restores mock.method() implementations (#36886)
- fix(ext/node): support assert message functions and format arguments (#36944)
- fix(npm): validate package link names (#37047)
- fix(tls): distrust compromised eMudhra certificate authorities (#37046)
- fix: bump rand 0.9.x to patched version

Introduced Cargo's own linting system: some Cargo warnings are now emitted as lints that users can control in the `[lints.cargo]` table. This includes a new built-in unused dependency check via the `cargo::unused_dependencies` lint. [docs](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html) [\#17298](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17298) - Introduced minimum publish age configurations, also known as dependency cooldowns. When the relevant config is set, the resolver ignores versions published more recently than that, unless they are already in `Cargo.lock`. ([RFC 3923](https://rust-lang.github.io/rfcs/3923-cargo-min-publish-age.html)) [docs](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/resolver.html#publish-age) [\#17335](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17335) - cargo-install: now uses the existing lockfile in the `.crate` tarball by default. `--locked` in cargo install becomes a no-op. [\#17388](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17388) - Cargo now uses a new directory layout for intermediate build artifacts. Tools that inspect the build directory may need to use [Cargo’s JSON messages](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/external-tools.html#json-messages) to locate build artifacts instead of relying on the build directory layout. The layout is not a stable interface and is subject to change. ([build cache doc](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/build-cache.html)) [\#17354](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17354) ## Rustdoc - [Add new `invalid_markdown_table` rustdoc lint](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/159583) ## Compatibility Notes - [Closures now more precisely capture variables used in `if let`. This may cause new errors](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/154210) - [Check dyn-compatibility of trait objects in more places](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/154992) - [`Infallible` is now a type alias to `!`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155499) - [The never type fallback was changed to `!` on all editions](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155499) - [`box` patterns are no longer syntactically allowed](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/156749) - [Report Query Cycle errors in more cases when computing the layout of enums with explicit discriminants](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157562) - [Always escape grapheme extenders in `str::escape_debug`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158303) - [Make let-else respect `macro_rules` `expr` metavariable grouping](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158515) - [`Iterator::{min,max}(_by_key)` changed which `Ord` methods they use.](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160203) This cannot change behaviour (other than being potentially faster) for types correctly following the [`Ord` rules](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/cmp/trait.Ord.html), but may impact types with inconsistent trait implementations. - [Emit an error when trying to enable SSE/AVX on an x86 (32bit or 64bit) softfloat target](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160302) - [Require windowed (and exception) for Xtensa ABI](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160643) - [windows-gnullvm: always link libunwind statically](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160712) - [From version 1.94 up to 1.100 a number of ARMv7-A hardfloat targets required the `VFPv3-D32` FPU as a minimum, as they erroneously had the `d32` feature in their baseline list of features. Breakage introduced as a result of correcting this can be fixed by passing `-Ctarget-feature=+d32` to Rust.](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160911) - [Change "Rust" ABI on x86 to use SSE registers if they are always-available for the current target](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161583) - [Make the `ambiguous_glob_imported_traits` lint fire in slightly more cases](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161805) - [Make `+fix-cortex-a53-835769` a default feature for `aarch64-unknown-fuchsia`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161886) - [Some impls on `Box` have been generalised to arbitrary allocators, which may cause new type inference errors](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161946) - [The standard library now uses Unicode version 18.0.0](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/primitive.char.html#associatedconstant.UNICODE_VERSION) - [WASI SDK version was bumped from 33 to 34](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/163809) - [On ARM targets, `-Ctarget-feature`/`-Ctarget-cpu` values that would alter the ABI are rejected as hard errors now.](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161280) ## Other - [Test harness now allows passing `--test-threads` and `--color` multiple times, with later arguments overriding earlier ones](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161312)

astral-sh/uv.body:
## Release Notes

Released on 2026-11-12.

### Python

- Add CPython 3.16.0a2 ([#23211](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23211))
- Update managed CPython 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14, and 3.15 builds to include pip 26.3, zlib 1.4, and Expat 2.10.0 ([#23211](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23211))
- Update GraalPy 3.13.0 to build 25.5.5 ([#23088](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23088))

### Preview features

- Install wheel variants from local paths, direct URLs, and Git repositories in platform-specific resolutions ([#22720](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22720), [#22722](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22722), [#22724](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22724))
- Detect x86-64 microarchitecture levels and AArch64 architecture versions when selecting wheel variants ([#22832](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22832), [#22949](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22949))
- Detect Google TPUs up when selecting wheel variants ([#23066](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23066), [#23121](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23121))
- Fix CPU detection for wheel variants on macOS with GraalPy ([#23089](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23089))
- Report quarantined packages in `uv audit` when index URLs differ only in redacted query values ([#23129](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23129))

### Performance

- Avoid duplicate environment builds when concurrent `uvx` or `uv run --with` invocations need the same environment ([#23123](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23123))

### Bug fixes

- Restrict Unix plaintext credential files to owner-only permissions ([#23209](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23209))
- Honor per-index `exclude-newer-package` cutoffs during resolution ([#23122](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23122))
- Respect negative extra markers on constraints ([#23144](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23144))
- Resolve dependencies of recursive extras from a scoped override ([#23210](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23210))
- Fix `activate.bat` for Windows virtual environments whose paths contain apostrophes ([#23152](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23152))

### Documentation

- Document the shell requirement for GitLab CI job images ([#23078](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23078))

## Install uv 0.13.8

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.8/uv-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.8/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

## Verifying GitHub Artifact Attestations

The artifacts in this release have attestations generated with GitHub Artifact Attestations. These can be verified by using the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_attestation_verify):
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --repo astral-sh/uv
```

You can also download the attestation from [GitHub](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/attestations) and verify against that directly:
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --bundle <file-path of downloaded attestation>
```
